content: {"episode_id":"ep-05146","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-50","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-50 denial of CPT 93229, Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring, as not medically necessary. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with intermittent palpitations (R00.2) and a known history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10). Per the ordering note, mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate these symptomatic episodes with underlying arrhythmias and assess for ischemic changes in the context of established coronary artery disease. These documented indications meet the clinical criteria for this diagnostic modality, and we request reconsideration and payment of the outstanding balance of $552.40."}
